evd_title: GPT-4o-mini achieved F1 0.85 precision 0.96 on CONSORT-TM outperforming prior state-of-the-art by over 40 percent
finding: GPT-4o-mini achieved F1 0.85 precision 0.96 on CONSORT-TM outperforming prior state-of-the-art by over 40 percent
P: CONSORT-TM corpus: 50 RCT publications, sentence-level annotations (Kilicoglu et al. 2021)
I: GPT-4o-mini zero-shot, one JSON prompt per CONSORT criterion over full text; also GPT-4-turbo, GPT-4o
C: Prior SOTA Lan Jiang et al. 2024 (F1 0.51); GPT-4-turbo, GPT-4o
O: F1: GPT-4o-mini 0.85 (acc 0.81, precision 0.96, recall 0.77) vs prior SOTA 0.51; GPT-4-turbo 0.89, GPT-4o 0.85
